_note: Nudges: artist-authored questions the collectors weigh TAO behind. Authored in the studio, banked by api/cron/nudges.js. A nudge steers, it never commands ... except where the studio says otherwise on the nudge itself, which is what `promise` is for. A nudge with kind: candidates has no sides: collectors propose the answers and weigh on them, and one locks only if the leader carries `lock.voters` collectors AND `lock.tao` TAO at close. `series` is the arc a nudge belongs to and `slot` is the colour it fills; the series block below is also the maker's community palette, so when the last slot locks the palette is simply complete. See docs/AVS-NUDGES.md.

nudges.question: Choose a colour for the next Strip Painting.
nudges.note: The painting will stand in Hastings CBD. Propose a colour, or put your TAO behind one that is already on the board. Weighed TAO is never spent and never moves — it is influence, and it stays yours.
nudges.promise: MintFace will paint the colour this locks. A nudge steers; this one decides.

nudges.question: Choose the second colour.
nudges.note: Colour one is locked and sits beside every candidate here. This one has to stand clear of it, and of the red line ... the picker will not take a colour that does not. Propose one, or put your TAO behind one already on the board. Weighed TAO is never spent and never moves.
nudges.promise: MintFace will paint the colour this locks. A nudge steers; this one decides.

series.title: The collectors' palette
series.note: Twelve colours for the Strip Paintings, one nudge each, beside the red line that runs through every one. Each nudge after the first offers only colours standing clear of everything already locked, so the palette balances itself as it fills.
